Trump is preparing to declare a national emergency to hijack our elections. Yet, the president has NO constitutional role in elections – only the states and Congress have that power.

Trump wants to cast doubt on our elections and scare people from voting. These threats must be taken seriously.
posts.summary: Opposes Trump's claimed election emergency powers as unconstitutional

Students and families will pay the price of the Big Beautiful Bill’s cuts to SNAP benefits. As schools lose eligibility, students will go hungry and families will shoulder an additional cost to already-strained budgets.

American children deserve to learn free of hunger and financial burden.

posts.text: Exciting news: Illinois rideshare drivers are now covered under sectoral bargaining. This new model benefits all rideshare drivers facing low wages and threats of losing their jobs to robotaxis. Illinois joins Massachusetts and California on charting a new path forward in unionizing.

Today, the Trump administration announced a proposed rule that would strip “roadless area” protections from tens of millions of acres of national forest lands that were established by the U.S. Forest Service 25 years ago. At least 25 million people source their drinking water from watersheds that currently enjoy roadless area protections, with major cities such as Atlanta, Los Angeles, Phoenix, and Salt Lake City reliant on drinking water sourced from now-threatened forests. Outdoor user groups estimate that roadless national forests under threat protect more than 25,000 miles of trails, more than 8,600 climbing and bouldering routes, and more than 760 miles of whitewater paddling runs.
